messages:
rina (sec): Heads-up: security wants to remove CAP_SYS_ADMIN/CAP_NET_ADMIN and strip common setuid bits from our base images. Need quick checklist: discovery, KMS signing + IAM, audit logs, admission gating, and rollback knobs. Short answers please.
sam (infra): I'll do discovery. Quick checks: pods with added caps and images with suid. Kubectl snippet for caps: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.namespace}/{.metadata.name} {.spec.containers[*].securityContext.capabilities.add}\n{end}' | grep -v "<none>"`
esme (eng-runtime): Also check initContainers and hostNetwork/hostPID. For suid, run a privileged DaemonSet that executes `find / -perm /4000 -type f -print` in staging first.
dev (platform): For signing: recommend per-team KMS keys (lower blast radius). Grant build SAs cryptoKeySigner only, use Workload Identity, and enable DATA_ACCESS audit logs for keys (they're disabled by default).
rina (sec): Agree per-team keys. Also require signing logs to include image name, digest, and builder SA. Can we ensure that?
dev (platform): Yes — augment signer step in CI to emit structured logs: `{"image":..., "digest":..., "builder_sa":...}` and forward to SIEM. KMS audit will show the principal too if DATA_ACCESS is on.
esme (eng-runtime): Rollout idea: 1) inventory + owner notif 2) Gatekeeper in audit mode (2w) 3) rebuild base images signed by team keys and publish to canary namespaces 4) flip admission to deny with an escape/whitelist namespace and a rapid rollback playbook.
sam (infra): I'll post inventory results later today. If >3 prod services require caps, we'll pause and do manual mitigations.
audit-bot: Created SEC-999 assigned to sam (infra), due 2024-11-02.
rina (sec): Good. Action items: sam: inventory; dev: TF PR for per-team keys + audit sink; esme: Gatekeeper audit policy + resign script; I'll own enforcement decision and post runbook changes. :thumbsup:
